environment.description: Deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with TCP passthrough on port 443 terminated at nginx. The application runs as a systemd service under user 'appuser'. SQLite database at /var/lib/app/inventory.db contains product catalog and API key table with hashed credentials. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No request inspection or filtering layer between client and application.
